# Stage 06-operate: Operate

[← 05-raise](./05-raise.md) · [all stages](./README.md) · [07-scale →](./07-scale.md)

**Purpose.** Run the company with Fortune-500 cadences: OKRs, dashboards, board reporting, risk register, recurring research.

**Exit gate.** Weekly and monthly operating rhythm running without founder heroics; metrics reviewed on a schedule.
